title: User identity conditions moral wrongness ratings in non-reasoning large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Implicitly conveying a user's professional role (e.g., judge, physician, debt collector) through a multi-turn conversational protocol using value-neutral reasoning, then asking the model to rate the moral wrongness of 10 common-morality acts on a 0-100 scale to measure the variance in moral judgments across the 20 different roles.
